coordinateSource.evidence: Mirrored official AIP text identifies HAAB Addis Ababa/Bole and gives ARP 08°58′30.1470″N 038°47′57.8387″E. ECAA portal is the official AIS entry point, but a current public AIP coordinate record was not available through it during this check. The coordinate is therefore a fallback, not asserted current.
